problemStatement.ar: صمم نظام إشعارات يدعم push وemail وSMS. فيه إشعارات حرجة زي OTP وحملات تسويق ضخمة. لازم preferences، dedupe، وتعامل مع فشل المزوّدين.
problemStatement.en: Design a notification system supporting push, email, and SMS. Include critical OTP-style messages and huge marketing campaigns. Need preferences, dedupe, and provider failure handling.

prompt.ar: قبل التصميم: اسأل عن الـ scope واعمل حسبة.
prompt.en: Before designing: clarify scope and estimate.

text.ar: سألت عن القنوات والحجم لكل قناة
text.en: Asked about channels and volume per channel

ar.how: اسأل: transactional vs marketing؟ quiet hours؟
ar.examples: OTP SMS، order push، promo email.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: تعامل OTP زي marketing.

en.why: Cost and SLA differ a lot.
en.how: Ask: transactional vs marketing? quiet hours?
en.examples: OTP SMS, order push, promo email.
en.mistakes: Mistake: treating OTP like marketing.

text.ar: قدّرت 1B notifications/day وpeak factor
text.en: Estimated 1B notifications/day and peak factor

ar.how: قسّم by channel. OTP له latency صارم.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: queue واحدة لكل الأولويات.

en.how: Split by channel. OTP has strict latency.
en.tradeoffs: Marketing tolerates delay; OTP does not.
en.mistakes: Mistake: one queue for all priorities.

text.ar: وضّحت idempotency وdedupe window
text.en: Clarified idempotency and dedupe window

ar.how: Idempotency key per (user, template, entity).
ar.mistakes: خطأ: مفيش dedupe على SMS.

en.how: Idempotency key per (user, template, entity).
en.mistakes: Mistake: no SMS dedupe.

text.ar: سألت عن user preferences وdevice tokens
text.en: Asked about user preferences and device tokens

ar.how: Preference store + token registry.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: تبعت بعد opt-out بسبب cache stale.

en.how: Preference store + token registry.
en.mistakes: Mistake: sending after opt-out due to stale cache.

prompt.en: Describe ingestion, orchestration, and channels: push/email/SMS/in-app.

text.ar: 📊 API → Queue → Worker/Orchestrator → Push/Provider + DLQ
text.en: 📊 API → Queue → Worker/Orchestrator → Push/Provider + DLQ

ar.how: Ingest سريع 202. Workers يختاروا القناة حسب القواعد.
ar.tradeoffs: Sync send أبسط لـ OTP الداخلي الصغير.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: استدعاء FCM جوّا الـ request الأصلي.

en.how: Fast ingest 202. Workers pick channel by rules.
en.tradeoffs: Sync send is simpler for small internal OTP.
en.mistakes: Mistake: calling FCM inside the original request.

text.ar: Orchestrator: templates + rules + preference check
text.en: Orchestrator: templates + rules + preference check

ar.how: Render template، evaluate quiet hours، fanout devices.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: منطق القناة متكرر في كل producer.

en.how: Render template, evaluate quiet hours, fanout devices.
en.mistakes: Mistake: channel logic duplicated in every producer.

text.ar: Priority queues: critical / high / bulk
text.en: Priority queues: critical / high / bulk

ar.why: OTP لازم يعدّي قدام الـ promos.
ar.how: Separate topics + worker pools.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: fairness واحدة يخنق OTP وقت حملة.

en.why: OTP must pass ahead of promos.
en.how: Separate topics + worker pools.
en.mistakes: Mistake: one fairness lane choking OTP during a campaign.

text.ar: Provider adapters + DLQ + retry with backoff
text.en: Provider adapters + DLQ + retry with backoff

ar.how: Timeout، retry jitter، DLQ بعد N.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: infinite retry على invalid token.

en.how: Timeout, retry jitter, DLQ after N.
en.tradeoffs: Aggressive retry increases cost and duplicates.
en.mistakes: Mistake: infinite retry on invalid token.

prompt.ar: إزاي تـ scale مع bursts (flash sales) وper-channel providers؟
prompt.en: How do you scale for bursts (flash sales) and per-channel providers?

text.ar: Partition by user_id عشان ordering وdedupe المحلي
text.en: Partition by user_id for ordering and local dedupe

ar.how: Kafka key=user_id. Shard preference cache.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: random partition يكرّر ويرتّب غلط.

en.how: Kafka key=user_id. Shard preference cache.
en.tradeoffs: Hot users can melt a partition.
en.mistakes: Mistake: random partition causing dupes/bad order.

text.ar: Autoscale workers على lag؛ isolate bulk campaigns
text.en: Autoscale workers on lag; isolate bulk campaigns

ar.how: HPA على consumer lag. Campaigns على cluster منفصل.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: حملة تسويقية تشارك OTP workers.

en.how: HPA on consumer lag. Campaigns on a separate cluster.
en.tradeoffs: Isolation costs more but protects transactional.
en.mistakes: Mistake: marketing campaign sharing OTP workers.

text.ar: Token registry cache + provider connection pooling
text.en: Token registry cache + provider connection pooling

ar.how: Redis cache tokens. HTTP/2 pools لـ FCM.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: تفتح TCP جديد لكل send.

en.why: Device lookup is on the path.
en.how: Redis cache tokens. HTTP/2 pools to FCM.
en.mistakes: Mistake: opening a new TCP connection per send.

prompt.ar: SLIs: enqueue lag، delivery success، provider latency.
prompt.en: SLIs: enqueue lag, delivery success, provider latency.

text.ar: SLOs: OTP p99 < 3s، push success > 98%
text.en: SLOs: OTP p99 < 3s, push success > 98%

ar.how: End-to-end timestamp من ingest لـ provider accept.
ar.tradeoffs: Provider SLA خارج سيطرتك — اعمل budget.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: SLO واحد لكل الإشعارات.

en.why: Split SLO by channel and priority.
en.how: End-to-end timestamp from ingest to provider accept.
en.tradeoffs: Provider SLA is outside your control — budget it.
en.mistakes: Mistake: one SLO for all notifications.

text.ar: Alert على DLQ growth وprovider error codes
text.en: Alert on DLQ growth and provider error codes

ar.how: Page على 5xx spike. Ticket على 4xx invalid tokens.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: ignore DLQ لأنها 'async'.

en.how: Page on 5xx spike. Ticket on 4xx invalid tokens.
en.mistakes: Mistake: ignoring DLQ because it is 'async'.

text.ar: Track opt-out compliance violations = zero tolerance
text.en: Track opt-out compliance violations = zero tolerance

ar.how: Metric: sends after opt-out. Alert فوري.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: مفيش مقياس للـ preference misses.

en.how: Metric: sends after opt-out. Immediate alert.
en.mistakes: Mistake: no metric for preference misses.

prompt.ar: Provider outages، duplicate sends، quiet hours violations.
prompt.en: Provider outages, duplicate sends, quiet hours violations.

text.ar: Provider rate limits وقت الحمل
text.en: Provider rate limits under load

ar.how: Smooth send، multi-provider، pre-negotiated quotas.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: burst كامل على provider واحد.

en.how: Smooth send, multi-provider, pre-negotiated quotas.
en.mistakes: Mistake: full burst to one provider.

text.ar: Duplicate sends من at-least-once
text.en: Duplicate sends from at-least-once

ar.how: Idempotency store قبل الـ provider call.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: تعتمد على provider dedupe بس.

en.how: Idempotency store before provider call.
en.tradeoffs: True exactly-once is rare with providers.
en.mistakes: Mistake: relying only on provider dedupe.

text.ar: Template render CPU في الحمل الكبير
text.en: Template render CPU under heavy load

ar.how: Pre-render لما ممكن. Cache fragments.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: render ثقيل على critical OTP path.

en.how: Pre-render when possible. Cache fragments.
en.mistakes: Mistake: heavy render on critical OTP path.

prompt.ar: Sync vs async send، وpriority queues.
prompt.en: Sync vs async send, and priority queues.

text.ar: Push-first vs SMS-first للـ OTP
text.en: Push-first vs SMS-first for OTP

ar.how: جرّب push؛ fallback SMS لو مفيش receipt.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: SMS دايمًا = تكلفة بتولّع.

en.how: Try push; fallback SMS if no receipt.
en.mistakes: Mistake: always SMS = burning money.

text.ar: Central notification service vs library in each app
text.en: Central notification service vs library in each app

ar.how: Central للـ companies الكبيرة.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: كل فريق يعمل Twilio لوحده.

en.how: Central for larger companies.
en.tradeoffs: Central can become an org bottleneck.
en.mistakes: Mistake: every team integrating Twilio alone.

text.ar: At-least-once + dedupe vs best-effort
text.en: At-least-once + dedupe vs best-effort

ar.how: Transactional: dedupe. Marketing: best-effort OK.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: best-effort على دفع/OTP.

en.how: Transactional: dedupe. Marketing: best-effort OK.
en.mistakes: Mistake: best-effort on payments/OTP.

text.ar: Idempotency key عبر القنوات لنفس الحدث
text.en: Idempotency key across channels for the same event

ar.why: مفيش push + SMS لنفس OTP بالغلط.
ar.how: Key يشمل channel strategy decision.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: dedupe per channel بس.

en.why: No accidental push + SMS for same OTP.
en.how: Key includes channel strategy decision.
en.mistakes: Mistake: dedupe per channel only.

text.ar: Quiet hours وtimezone صحيحة
text.en: Correct quiet hours and timezones

ar.how: خزّن tz لليوزر. Postpone bulk.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: UTC على كل الناس.

en.how: Store user tz. Postpone bulk.
en.mistakes: Mistake: UTC for everyone.

text.ar: Template versioning وcanary
text.en: Template versioning and canary

ar.how: Version pin + canary % + kill switch.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: نشر template على 100% مباشرة.

en.how: Version pin + canary % + kill switch.
en.mistakes: Mistake: shipping a template to 100% immediately.

prompt.ar: تكلفة SMS vs push vs email عند 1B notifications/day.
prompt.en: Cost of SMS vs push vs email at 1B notifications/day.

text.ar: SMS هو غالب التكلفة؛ ادفع push/email بديل
text.en: SMS dominates cost; prefer push/email alternatives

ar.how: احسب mix: 1B × channel cost.
ar.tradeoffs: Push رخيص بس مش دايمًا reachable.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: تقدير من غير channel mix.

en.how: Compute mix: 1B × channel cost.
en.tradeoffs: Push is cheap but not always reachable.
en.mistakes: Mistake: estimating without channel mix.

text.ar: Queue/storage للـ retries وdedupe keys
text.en: Queue/storage for retries and dedupe keys

ar.how: TTL على dedupe 24–72h. Compress payloads.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: تخزن body كبير في الـ queue للأبد.

en.how: TTL on dedupe 24–72h. Compress payloads.
en.mistakes: Mistake: storing large bodies in queue forever.

text.ar: Provider commits: reserved capacity vs on-demand
text.en: Provider commits: reserved capacity vs on-demand

ar.how: Reserve لـ OTP. On-demand للـ marketing.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: on-demand بس وقت رمضان/BF.

en.how: Reserve for OTP. On-demand for marketing.
en.mistakes: Mistake: on-demand only during Ramadan/BF.

prompt.ar: Consent، opt-out، PII في الـ payloads.

text.ar: Consent & opt-out كـ source of truth قوية
text.en: Consent & opt-out as strong source of truth

ar.how: Strong read قبل send. Invalidate caches فورًا.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: eventual opt-out على marketing الكبير.

en.how: Strong read before send. Invalidate caches immediately.
en.mistakes: Mistake: eventual opt-out on large marketing.

text.ar: قلّل PII في الـ payloads والسجلات
text.en: Minimize PII in payloads and logs

ar.how: IDs بدل أرقام تليفون في الـ body لما ممكن. Mask logs.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: log OTP codes.

en.how: IDs instead of phone numbers in body when possible. Mask logs.
en.mistakes: Mistake: logging OTP codes.

text.ar: Auth بين الخدمات + signed webhooks من providers
text.en: Auth between services + signed provider webhooks

ar.how: mTLS/JWT داخلي. HMAC على webhooks.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: webhook مفتوح من غير توقيع.

en.how: Internal mTLS/JWT. HMAC on webhooks.
en.mistakes: Mistake: open webhook without signature.

prompt.ar: Multi-region: local quiet hours وprovider failover.
prompt.en: Multi-region: local quiet hours and provider failover.

text.ar: Multi-provider failover runbook
text.en: Multi-provider failover runbook

ar.how: Health checks + weighted routing + manual override.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: مفيش provider تاني متعاقد.

en.how: Health checks + weighted routing + manual override.
en.mistakes: Mistake: no contracted secondary provider.

text.ar: Regional quiet-hours وdata residency
text.en: Regional quiet-hours and data residency

ar.how: Store preferences/regionally route sends.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: region واحد لكل العالم.

en.how: Store preferences/regionally route sends.
en.mistakes: Mistake: one region for the whole world.

text.ar: Replay من DLQ بعد إصلاح القالب/المزوّد
text.en: Replay from DLQ after fixing template/provider

ar.how: Tooling للـ selective replay مع dedupe.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: replay أعمى لكل الـ DLQ.

en.how: Tooling for selective replay with dedupe.
en.mistakes: Mistake: blindly replaying the entire DLQ.

rangeHint.ar: مفتاح dedupe صغير عادة عشرات البايت.
rangeHint.en: A dedupe key is usually tens of bytes.

rangeHint.ar: تكلفة SMS تختلف حسب الدولة حوالي ١–٤ سنت.
rangeHint.en: SMS cost varies by country around 1–4 cents.

steps.ar: 2) SMS volume = day × sms%. Cost = volume × cents.
steps.en: 2) SMS volume = day × sms%. Cost = volume × cents.

steps.ar: 3) Dedupe storage ≈ daily × retention days × bytes.
steps.en: 3) Dedupe storage ≈ daily × retention days × bytes.

description.ar: Push provider مش بيرد. OTP والـ marketing متأثرين. إيه الخطة؟
description.en: Push provider is not responding. OTP and marketing affected. What is the plan?

checklist.ar: DLQ مع dedupe جاهز للـ replay
checklist.en: DLQ with dedupe ready for replay

description.ar: Marketing enqueue ملايين الرسائل. OTP latency طالع.
description.en: Marketing enqueued millions. OTP latency is up.

expectedNote.ar: Async هو الافتراضي؛ sync نادر لـ OTP الداخلي الصغير.
expectedNote.en: Async is the default; sync is rare for small internal OTP.

whenOtherWins.ar: Sync لو الحجم صغير ومفيش providers خارجيين بطيئين.
whenOtherWins.en: Sync if volume is small and there are no slow external providers.

expectedNote.ar: Push-first يوفّر فلوس لو الـ reach كويس.
expectedNote.en: Push-first saves money when reach is good.

whenOtherWins.ar: SMS لو جمهور بدون apps أو تنظيم صارم.
whenOtherWins.en: SMS if the audience lacks apps or regulation is strict.

caption.en: A service produces a notification event
